items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: I think that's Joe Mitchell, if I'm not mistaken. He played Gana. And he also played Sticks. Marimba. Marimba. Marimba.

ctx.x: But I think we got it all in here somewhere, aren't we?
Yeah. Remember the battery, not Mitchell? Probably.
Well, Joe Mitchell? Remember him? Yeah. Who is he?
